summary: Balance with Wrath as the only filler, for a moonkin that would rather not weave.
rotation: Pre-pull: Wrath cast 1.5s before the pull
Racials, potions and runes on cooldown (Innervate on its own trigger)
Insect Swarm whenever it is down (more than 8s of fight left)
Moonfire whenever its dot is down (more than 8s of fight left)
Moonfire when a Wrath plus 1.5s would not land before the end
caveats: Natural Power gloves are +8.1 over Arcane Power.
Subtlety 3 (Restoration, threat) is a must-take (standards 26): costs 2.9 / 2.9 / 3.0 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec balance with the Wrath gear variant, apl and talents; same consumes, buffs and encounter as the Balance build (shared EncounterLevel60). Duration 180s, durationVariation 20. No edits needed.
